defmodule CryptoAuth.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Cross-service authentication token verifier with redirect handling.
  Uses HMAC-SHA256 for token integrity verification.
  """

  @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:crypto_auth, :hmac_secret) ||
              raise("CryptoAuth: :hmac_secret must be configured; refusing to use a random/default HMAC key")
  @allowed_schemes ["https"]
  @token_ttl_seconds 300

  defstruct [:service_id, :timestamp, :redirect_uri, :nonce]

  def verify_and_redirect(conn, token_b64, signature_b64) do
    with {:ok, token_bytes} <- Base.url_decode64(token_b64, padding: false),
         {:ok, sig_bytes} <- Base.url_decode64(signature_b64, padding: false),
         :ok <- verify_signature(token_bytes, sig_bytes),
         {:ok, claims} <- decode_claims(token_bytes),
         :ok <- verify_freshness(claims),
         {:ok, redirect_url} <- validate_redirect(claims.redirect_uri) do
      conn
      |> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header("location", redirect_url)
      |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(302, "")
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(403, "Authentication failed: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  defp verify_signature(payload, provided_sig) do
    computed = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, payload)
    if secure_compare(computed, provided_sig) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) != byte_size(b), do: false
  defp secure_compare(a, b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end

  defp decode_claims(token_bytes) do
    case :erlang.binary_to_term(token_bytes, [:safe]) do
      %{service_id: sid, timestamp: ts, redirect_uri: uri, nonce: n}
      when is_binary(sid) and is_integer(ts) and is_binary(uri) and is_binary(n) ->
        {:ok, %__MODULE__{service_id: sid, timestamp: ts, redirect_uri: uri, nonce: n}}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp verify_freshness(%__MODULE__{timestamp: ts}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - ts) <= @token_ttl_seconds do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :token_expired}
    end
  end

  defp validate_redirect(uri_string) do
    parsed = URI.parse(uri_string)
    cond do
      parsed.scheme in @allowed_schemes and valid_host?(parsed.host) ->
        {:ok, URI.to_string(parsed)}
      parsed.scheme == nil and parsed.host == nil and not protocol_relative?(uri_string) ->
        # Relative path - allow as safe internal redirect
        {:ok, uri_string}
      true ->
        {:error, :invalid_redirect}
    end
  end

  defp protocol_relative?(uri) do
    String.starts_with?(uri, "//") or String.starts_with?(uri, "\\\\") or
    String.contains?(uri, "@")
  end

  defp valid_host?(nil), do: false
  defp valid_host?(host) do
    allowed_domains = Application.get_env(:crypto_auth, :allowed_domains, ["auth.example.com", "app.example.com"])
    Enum.any?(allowed_domains, fn domain ->
      host == domain or String.ends_with?(host, "." <> domain)
    end)
  end
end

defmodule CryptoAuth.TokenIssuer do
  @moduledoc """
  Issues signed authentication tokens for cross-service redirects.
  """

  @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:crypto_auth, :hmac_secret) ||
              raise("CryptoAuth: :hmac_secret must be configured; refusing to use a random/default HMAC key")

  def issue_token(service_id, redirect_uri) do
    claims = %{
      service_id: service_id,
      timestamp: System.system_time(:second),
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      nonce: Base.encode64(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16))
    }

    payload = :erlang.term_to_binary(claims)
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, payload)

    {
      Base.url_encode64(payload, padding: false),
      Base.url_encode64(signature, padding: false)
    }
  end
end
